minor.issue: Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies (FastifyAdapter's default formbody parser), e.g. curl -d 'label=x&source=cli' -> 201. A cross-site HTML form 'simple request' can therefore write rows without a CORS preflight. Low risk now (no auth, synthetic data) but worth restricting to application/json before auth/tenant work units.
